sample_labels.GSM2895008: WT B. subtilis 3610 delta-epsH, exponential LB

signal_units: Depositor-normalized mapped-end signal (paper describes reads per million non-rRNA/non-tRNA reads).
calculation: For selected WT peak p, local median uses all genomic positions p-50..p+50 with abs(q-p)>5, treating absent WIG entries as zero. Peak/local median is descriptive; no statistical threshold.
selection: Known paper-identified windows were chosen before reading WIG maxima; not a blind genome-wide discovery.
missingness: delta-yaaT reverse 5-prime filename lacks explicit _5_r suffix in archive; excluded from reverse-end comparison to avoid assuming filename identity. Its explicit forward track was used for glnRA, and explicit reverse 3-prime track for rnpB.
scope: One deposited processed track per genotype; no biological-replicate model. Not a raw-read reanalysis.
download_failure: PNAS supplementary XLSX retrieval returned anti-bot HTML; those files were renamed .failed.html and not used. GEO processed tracks were successfully downloaded and parsed.
